questions.question: You are generating image-text retrieval queries for pedestrian/person-attribute crops. Use the structured visual description generated from the image. Generate retrieval queries using only visible/supported attributes. Return a JSON string with exactly this shape: {"queries":{"easy":[],"medium":[],"hard":[]}}. Easy queries: use only upper clothing and bottom clothing; include primary color plus clothing type; do not include shoes, accessories, viewpoint, action, gender, age, skin tone, or background; generate exactly 10 diverse queries; include both phrase-style and sentence-style queries; include ordering variation; include color synonyms or fine-grained color wording when appropriate. Medium queries: use upper clothing, bottom clothing, shoes if visible, and action if visible; include shoe color and shoe type only if both are visible; do not include accessories, viewpoint, gender, age, skin tone, or background; generate exactly 10 diverse queries; include both phrase-style and sentence-style queries; include ordering variation; include color synonyms or fine-grained color wording when appropriate. Hard queries: use upper clothing, bottom clothing, shoes if visible, accessories if visible, viewpoint if visible, and action if visible; generate exactly 10 diverse natural-language queries; include both phrase-style and sentence-style queries; include ordering variation; include color synonyms or fine-grained color wording when appropriate; hard queries should be natural retrieval queries, not rigid templates. Forbidden: do not mention gender; do not mention age; do not mention skin tone; do not mention ethnicity; do not mention background; do not hallucinate accessories, shoes, action, or viewpoint; if action is not clearly visible, omit action; do not use matching for colors, always state explicit colors; do not use vague clothing words if a specific attribute is available. Color synonym guidance: black: charcoal black, dark charcoal, jet black; blue: navy blue, denim blue, light blue, dark blue, royal blue; grey: light grey, dark grey, charcoal grey, heather grey, silver; white: off-white, pure white; red: maroon, bright red, crimson, burgundy; green: olive green, dark green, teal, mint green; brown: dark brown, olive brown; beige: tan, khaki, cream, light beige; yellow: mustard yellow, pale yellow, bright yellow; orange: bright orange, burnt orange, terracotta; pink: light pink, dusty pink, rose pink; purple: dark purple, lavender, violet; camouflage: green camouflage, grey camouflage, dark green camouflage. Output requirements: return exactly 10 easy queries, 10 medium queries, and 10 hard queries; every query must be useful for image-text retrieval; queries within each difficulty level should be semantically equivalent but phrased differently; use only attributes supported by the visual description; return the final result as the free-form answer for this question.
